C1404.title: Case Study of the Compound Governance Attack
C1404.summary: In July 2024, the Compound DAO suffered a governance attack: a group called the Golden Boys, led by whale Humpy, pushed through Proposal 289 to transfer about 5% of the COMP treasury (roughly 499,000 COMP, worth approximately USD 24 million) to a goldCOMP vault under their control for one year. The proposal narrowly passed 682,191 to 633,636, and the community accused it of being a coordinated governance attack. The incident exposed the inherent vulnerability of on-chain DAO governance where voting power is determined by token holdings.
